mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_board ( title, contents, created_datetime, creator_id ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{contents}, NOW(), #{creatorId} )
mapper.select: SELECT board_id, title, contents, creator_id, hit_cnt, created_datetime FROM t_board WHERE deleted_yn = "N" ORDER BY board_id DESC
SELECT board_id, title, contents, creator_id, hit_cnt, created_datetime FROM t_board WHERE board_id = #{boardId} AND deleted_yn = "N"
mapper.update: UPDATE t_board SET title = #{title}, contents = #{contents}, updated_datetime = NOW(), updater_id = "updater" WHERE board_id = #{boardId}
